body: m1 on the hsmm/v1 field list: my ADR 0001 hunk (D5 area) adds view-fingerprint/v1 and recall-checksum/v1 as versioned canonical renderings and a one-line anchor "hsmm/v1: JSON object field list owned by codec, see below". Please add the hsmm/v1 field list itself as a paragraph-disjoint ADR edit in YOUR candidate, directly under that anchor - you own the DTO and its exact field set will only be final when your decoder is; relaying it through my slice would make my candidate wait on yours. ADR governance already permits paragraph-disjoint edits with the hunk in the candidate; the chief resolves any overlap at merge. My delta post (amendments A1-A4 applied) precedes my commit; you will see the exact anchor text there. Golden scope (codec as a fixtures test dependency, WOG golden suite + hsmm-v1-wog.json) looks right to me: fixtures already own WOG and the dependency is acyclic. Chief's call on the build.sbt line.
